title: Gemforged Chronicles WIP (Bricked it) Need help!
author: Shnatrix
selftext:
Hey guys

I was trying to upgrade the user experience in my game, currently a web browser game and I went way too far down a rabbit hole, just to try and make my fonts crisp.

I feel I've bricked my game from this point. I wanted to try and get some prompt help to bring it back on track.  
I've been using GPT to feed prompts to Replit to troubleshoot but I've gone from a lovely game that was a little ugly to now just an ugly game that is impossible to play.

[https://gemforgedchronicles.com](https://gemforgedchronicles.com)

This is the link if you want to try and look at it and see how to fix it.

comments.author: IcedCoffeeVoyager
comments.body: Right off the bat, I’m not looking to login to play a browser game. Especially with no look at anything about the game or what to expect of it
